title: i love this app
body: i have used this app when it first came out and then i stopped using it for a few years, when i looked back i realized i still used some habits i had learned from the app and got back on track. if you want to make change and you work for it, this app will help you and be a guide for you. for me it’s a big personal investment that comes back as valuable lessons.
author: aiiisk

title: Exceptional motivation
body: Fabulous made a great job at creating content that is actually motivating to the core! It is filled with interesting insights, that one might have forgotten about to even consider. It made me remember some virtues that we, as humans, do have, but did not reach them because I was following either a wrong path or the right path in the wrong way and with wrong intentions. Fabulous makes you feel loved, makes you love yourself. It lays challenges in front of one not for the sake of changing, but for the sake of comprehension: we do not have boundaries, we are already the best we have ever been, so why not continue that path of greatness and reach for even better every day.
author: NadinaCosic
